newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Mexico lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grupo Mexico lowered.

text.p: Valores Finamex analyst Christopher Albi downgraded his recommendation on Grupo Mexico to market underperformer from market performer.
-- He said in a report on Thursday that the giant copper and zinc producer will be held back by declining copper prices.
"Even with big increases in metallic copper production, GMexico's earnings per share will fall two percent this year to 4.307 pesos and rise just three percent in 1998 to 4.434 pesos," he wrote.
Despite the negative outlook for copper prices, Albi noted that the company's aim of becoming a fully integrated metal producer will improve margins.

"Investors who want to catch the gains we expect from the stock in the next big copper upturn may want to hold on now, especially since the stock has a floor supported by strong fundamentals," he wrote.
The company's shares rose 0.50 peso in early trading from Wednesday's close of 31 pesos.
